title: Blog moderation

feeds.label: Post lists
feeds.note: Pinning and marking a post global need their own permissions.

hide.title: Hide “{title}”?
hide.body: The post leaves the feed and this list. Only its authors and staff can open it by its link.

gap: No API yet — the abuse-report queue (there is no report model yet), search and bulk actions. A post whose content needs fixing opens by its link, then the edit screen.
